_note: Every animal's own attack style (scripts/battle/battle_styles.gd; how it looks: battle_field.gd and fx/style_look.gd). line: what holding its card shows (8 words or fewer). kind: which style. The rest are its numbers: times in seconds, distances in tiles, pct in percent (of its bite, or of the damage it takes).

brown_bear.line: Big swipes hit two at once.

snapping_turtle.line: Hides in its shell when hurt.

giant_panda.line: Sits down for a bamboo snack heal.

hippopotamus.line: Thick hide bites back at attackers.

asian_elephant.line: Shields the friends right behind it.

black_rhino.line: Charges through the enemy line first.

yeti.line: Every third hit: icy ground pound.
